candidates.yourNature_desc: You are the night rain that never quite finds a roof. Everything reaches you at full strength, yours and everyone else's, all day, and the sorting of whose feeling is whose never fully clocks out. Most of what soaks in grows something. Some of it was never yours to hold. Telling the difference is the quiet work of your life.

self_card.presence: Everything reaches you at full strength, all of it, all day. Feeling this much is weather work, and nobody hands out coats for it.
